RuleDescription: Use non-empty F001 as the only operational-record detection basis.
Notes: Do not infer records from other populated columns.

RuleDescription: Compare operational record count with the approved 1405 baseline.
Normalize recognized Process Result variants to the standard ProcessStatus.
Report values not included in the approved Process Result mapping.
Notes: No unknown values were found in validated 1405 operational records.

RuleDescription: Separate populated cells outside operational records from data-quality errors.
Notes: Do not treat as record-count evidence.

RuleDescription: Report duplicate RecordID values within a sheet.
Notes: Global RecordKey will be introduced for cross-year uniqueness.

RuleDescription: Validate expected sheets and headers.
AssetType should be recognizable in the approved classification.
Notes: Final controlled list remains subject to master-data approval.

RuleDescription: WorkType should be recognizable in the approved work-type classification.
Notes: Final list remains subject to business approval.

RuleDescription: Operator should be mappable to Employee Master when required.
Customer should be mappable to Customer Master when required.
RequestingUnit should be mappable to the approved organizational-unit master.
SubGroup should be mappable to the approved SubGroup classification.
Notes: SubGroup is broader than production units and may include outsourcing/project domains.

RuleDescription: MoldCode must be stored as Text.
Notes: Preserve leading zeros and code structure.

RuleDescription: Standardize Latin letters in MoldCode in the processed layer.
Repair-mold records should have a MoldCode.
Notes: Target system should make this an ERROR after coding process is established; 1405 is legacy.

RuleDescription: For a new mold, a valid MoldCode or ProductTechnicalNo must exist.
Notes: ProductTechnicalNo is a future independent standard field.

RuleDescription: RequestLetterNo must always be stored as Text.
Notes: Supports numeric and mixed-format request identifiers.

RuleDescription: Control leading/trailing spaces in RequestLetterNo.
RequestLetterNo should be traceable when the activity requires a formal request.
Notes: Business rule depends on activity type.

RuleDescription: FailureDescriptionRaw must not be overwritten.
Notes: Future FailureCategory can be added separately.

RuleDescription: Flag blank or extremely short failure descriptions where a failure description is expected.
Notes: Minimum length threshold to be finalized.

RuleDescription: Quantity must be numerically interpretable.
Notes: Exact business unit depends on AssetType/WorkType.

RuleDescription: Quantity must not be negative.
Notes: Zero/positive acceptance remains conditional by work type.

RuleDescription: For mold work, Quantity represents the number of mold sets/items requested, not internal components.
Notes: A mold set normally remains Quantity=1 even if it contains multiple components.

RuleDescription: Do not increase mold Quantity because of the number of internal mold components.
Notes: ComponentQuantity is a future separate concept.

RuleDescription: Quantity should be consistent with AssetType and WorkType.
Requester should be identifiable when a formal request exists.
Control spelling/spacing variants of Requester names.
Requester should be mappable to the employee/requester master in the future.
RelatedMachineCode must be stored as Text.
Notes: Applies to production, service, outsourcing and repair contexts.

RuleDescription: RelatedMachineCode should be mappable to Machine Master.
Notes: Machine can be linked to mold, part or machine repair.

RuleDescription: Where a record is clearly related to a machine, the relevant machine code should be captured.
Notes: Do not infer code from machine name.

RuleDescription: Station should be mappable to Station Master.
Detect spelling/format variants of station names.
Machine should be mappable to Machine Master.
Notes: Machine name is descriptive; official code remains separate.

RuleName: Machine name is not machine code
RuleDescription: Do not use F015 Machine as a substitute for F013 RelatedMachineCode.
Notes: Keep descriptive name and official code conceptually separate.

RuleDescription: Part raw name must remain unchanged in the raw layer.
Notes: Standard PartName can be added separately.

RuleDescription: Detect variants of the same part name for standardization.
PartCode must always be stored as Text.
Leading zeros in PartCode must not be removed.
Notes: Treat code as identifier, not a numeric measure.

RuleDescription: PartCode should be retrievable/validated against Mold-Part Master where applicable.
System must not guess a PartCode when no valid master mapping exists.
Notes: Human review required if no mapping exists.

RuleDescription: OperationDescriptionRaw must remain unchanged.
Notes: OperationCode is a future standard concept.

RuleDescription: Flag blank or non-interpretable operation descriptions where an operation is expected.
Notes: Minimum completeness threshold to be finalized.

RuleDescription: ProcessResultRaw must not be overwritten.
Map OK/ok to OK and NOK/NC/غیر قابل تعمیر to NOK in the processed layer.
Notes: This mapping was validated on 1405 data.

RuleDescription: Report values outside the approved Process Result mapping.
Final standard treatment of blank Process Result must be explicitly approved.
HardeningSentDate must be a valid Persian date.
Notes: Standard date representation will be defined in processed layer.

RuleDescription: HardeningSentDate must respect the valid process sequence.
HardeningExecutor should map to Supplier/Executor Master.
Detect naming variants of hardening executors.
HardeningCost must be numeric and non-negative.
HardeningReceivedDate must be a valid Persian date.
Notes: F023 is the first of the two Raw 'تاریخ دریافت' columns.

RuleDescription: HardeningReceivedDate must not precede HardeningSentDate.
ChromeSentDate must be a valid Persian date.
ChromeSentDate should respect the known upstream process sequence.
ChromeExecutor should map to Supplier/Executor Master.
ChromeCost must be numeric and non-negative.
ChromeReceivedDate must be a valid Persian date.
Notes: F027 is the second Raw 'تاریخ دریافت' column.

RuleDescription: ChromeReceivedDate must not precede ChromeSentDate.
Month should match the source sheet/month context.
WorkDate must be a valid date consistent with the workbook's target year.
WorkShift should be interpretable as a time range when populated.
WorkedMinutes must be numeric and non-negative.
WorkedHours must be numeric and non-negative.
Check the consistency of WorkedMinutes and WorkedHours when both are available.
WorkedHours must never be used as the basis for operational-record detection.
OperatorLeave must be analytically separate from WorkedHours.
OperatorLeave must be interpretable according to its approved source convention.
Notes: Exact unit/meaning should be preserved from source until finalized.

RuleDescription: OperatorLeaveHours must be numeric and non-negative.

RuleName: Leave not added to worked time
RuleDescription: OperatorLeaveHours must not be added to WorkedHours.
Where both leave fields are used, their relationship should be checked.
Notes: Exact relationship depends on source convention.

RuleDescription: Notes must remain unchanged in Raw.
Potential date/amount/reason fields in Notes may be extracted later into structured fields.
Notes: Examples: leave reason, leave date, leave amount, delay reason.

RuleDescription: DamagedParts raw data must remain unchanged.
Notes: Exact business format still requires confirmation.

RuleDescription: DamagedParts should be connectable to Part Master when the business meaning is finalized.
Notes: Could contain names, counts or both; TBD.

RuleDescription: RecordedFailureCause must remain unchanged in Raw.
Equivalent failure-cause entries should be standardizable in a future controlled vocabulary.
F038 Raw value must remain unchanged until its business meaning is confirmed.
Notes: Observed values can include date/time or time ranges.

RuleDescription: Detect whether F038 contains date, datetime or time-range content.
Approver should be traceable to the relevant employee/approver master.
F040 must be a valid Persian date when populated.
Notes: Meaning includes repair delivery or production start.

RuleDescription: F041 must be a valid Persian date when populated.
Mold delivery to production should be traceable to the mold approval/handover process when applicable.
Presence/absence of F042 across sheets must be tracked as schema variation.
Normalize known F042 status variants without overwriting Raw.
UnitPrice must be numeric and non-negative.
WorkPrice must be numeric and non-negative.
Where meaningful, WorkPrice should be checked against Quantity and UnitPrice without assuming an exact formula.
LatheMachineDowntimeMinutes must be numeric and non-negative.
LatheMachineDowntimeHours must be numeric and non-negative.
Check consistency between downtime minutes and downtime hours.
Track unnamed column as a schema issue until business review.
Notes: Do not remove from Raw automatically.

RuleDescription: Do not remove or repurpose F047 without business review.
Raw source data must never be overwritten by the standardization process.
Standard field names must be independent of Raw header wording.
Notes: Supports schema drift and multi-year integration.

RuleDescription: Approved Master Data is the reference for standard codes/names where available.
MoldCode and ProductTechnicalNo are independent concepts.
Notes: Do not store ProductTechnicalNo in MoldCode.

RuleDescription: The relationship ProductTechnicalNo ↔ MoldCode must be traceable.
Notes: Implemented through future mold master/handover records.

RuleDescription: Mold-Part Mapping is a reference source for PartCode where applicable.
Notes: Master files will be supplied later.

RuleDescription: F007 SubGroup must not be limited to production units.
Notes: May include service and outsourcing/project domains.

RuleDescription: MoldInstallationLocation must be modeled separately from SubGroup.
RelatedMachineCode and Machine should be linkable to Machine Master while retaining distinct meanings.
Notes: F013 = code; F015 = descriptive machine field.

RuleDescription: RequestingUnit and Requester must remain separate concepts.
RecordID alone must not be assumed globally unique across months/years.
A cross-year RecordKey must be generated using approved period context plus RecordID.
MDR/Approval forms should be populated from standardized data rather than retyping Raw values.
Outsourcing projects should use a dedicated future data model but remain linkable to the core project model.
Notes: Dedicated outsourcing form planned for future.

RuleDescription: A new-mold case becomes eligible for the approval form when the work is completed and F041 MoldDeliveryToProductionDate is recorded.
Notes: No WorkedHours threshold applies to new molds.

RuleDescription: A repair-mold case becomes eligible for automatic approval-form generation when total WorkedHours for the RepairCase exceeds 20 hours, the repair is complete, and F041 is recorded.
Notes: Threshold applies to the aggregated RepairCase, not one row.

RuleDescription: WorkedHours must be aggregated at RepairCase level for the 20-hour approval threshold.
Notes: Temporary case key may use MoldCode + RequestLetterNo; future RepairCaseID is preferred.

RuleDescription: When all applicable trigger conditions are met, ApprovalFormRequired must be set to YES.
Generated approval forms must be populated from Standardized/Master data rather than manually retyped Raw values.
Each generated approval form must have ApprovalFormID and Version.
The same approval-form revision must not be generated more than once unless a new revision is required.
The final PDF approval form must be stored in MDR and linked back to its source Mold/Repair/Request context.
A change to material source/standard data after form generation must support creation of a new controlled form revision.
Notes: Do not silently overwrite a signed/printed record.

RuleDescription: A repair-mold case at or below 20 aggregated WorkedHours is not automatically eligible under the hour-threshold rule.
Notes: Other business reasons may still require a form later.

RuleDescription: New molds do not require a 20-hour minimum to trigger the approval form.
The PDF generator must use approved Standard fields and Master data.
Every generated form must receive a unique ApprovalFormID and controlled version.
Do not regenerate an unchanged form revision.
Generated approval PDF must be saved, registered in MDR, and made available for printing.
Notes: Printing status should be separately tracked.

RuleDescription: When a material field changes after a form is generated, create a new Revision rather than modifying the prior controlled record.
